name: LifterLMS
couldBuild: Courses, sections and lessons as post types, progress tracking, quizzes and a checkout that enrols the buyer.
stillMissing: Payments and their failure modes, certificates, drip scheduling, group and bulk enrolment, plus the integrations schools expect. The core is very buildable; the tail that makes it usable for a real cohort is where the year goes.
requirements: Course structure with sections, lessons and prerequisites
Progress tracking and completion rules per student
Quizzes with grading, attempts and pass marks
Enrolment via purchase, membership or manual assignment
Instructor and student dashboards with progress reporting
